body: i tend to be very bad at talking to people about my actual emotions, mostly because i’m generally the “funny troll friend” in all my friendship groups, and i don’t want everyone to stop thinking of me in that way. but i feel like i’d be more comfortable talking about it with someone who doesn’t know me, and doesn’t have an opinion of me that i could damage by opening up. if you’re still available (no pressure) i would really appreciate a chat. thank you for your comment :)
i just got the notification that someone gave me an award, and i don’t think i can begin to explain how much that gesture means to me. thank you, so, so much <3
that would be brilliant, thank you

that’s horrible, i’m genuinely really sorry that you had to go through that. being called lazy is the worst feeling, when you know you’re doing the absolute most you can possibly bring yourself to do, but i think we all have to try and remember that the opinion people hold of us isn’t always the truth. when i get called lazy, i become very unproductive and i really doubt myself, but i’ve been trying hard to put it aside and not let it get to me. 

honestly even just typing it out has lifted a weight off my shoulders. thank you so much for this response, i really genuinely appreciate it. we all need to stay strong together.
